findings.summary: The brief explicitly requires round-down behavior for an unreachable target ('the result should reflect the actual achievable weight (rounded down)'), but none of the 3 submitted tests exercise it — all three targets (82.5kg, 20kg, 100kg) are exactly achievable with the given plate set. Manual trace of the implementation confirms the round-down logic is correct (e.g. targetKg=22/barKg=20 correctly yields 20.0, targetKg=84 correctly yields 82.5), but there is no automated test guarding this named requirement, so a future refactor could silently break it.

findings.summary: Doc comment says 'rounds DOWN to the nearest achievable weight (see Task 1.7 for that case)' — referencing an internal plan task number inside production code. This will be meaningless/stale once the plan document is gone, and project convention (CLAUDE.md) is to not reference task/plan identifiers in code comments.
